test_reproducibility: test the TestReproducibility class to verify training produces identical results after resuming from a checkpoint
test_reproducibility_fp16: test the TestReproducibility class with FP16 precision flags to verify GPU-based half-precision training reproducibility
test_reproducibility_memory_efficient_fp: test the TestReproducibility class with memory-efficient FP16 flags to verify GPU-based memory-optimized training reproducibility
test_mid_epoch_reproducibility: test the TestReproducibility class with save-interval-updates to verify mid-epoch checkpoint resume produces identical results
test_train_language_model: test the train_language_model utility with streaming_language_modeling task and transformer_lm_gpt2_tiny architecture
